title: IPv6 Payload Length includes extension header
summary: The Payload Length for regular IPv6 starts counting after the fixed 40-byte base header, and extension headers are also in range.
applies: Offline IPv4 and IPv6 packet analysis
detail: To locate the upper layer data, the Next Header chain needs to be interpreted one by one. The first byte after the fixed header cannot be directly regarded as the starting point of TCP or UDP.
boundary: Extra options are used for the special case of oversized loads, and zero values cannot be unconditionally interpreted as ordinary empty loads.
relevance: Check the starting position and length of the application layer in the IPv6 packet capture.
